study: V99 R106 phase 16 — independent SIDEWAYS+HIGH_VOL relative-value alpha

precommitment.objective: add independent market-neutral alpha in the weakest F7 SIDEWAYS+HIGH_VOL cell rather than reducing the existing core
precommitment.tail_robustness: selected alpha must keep positive mean after removing its top 1% hourly winners
precommitment.fold_gate: >=3 valid train folds and >=3 positive/PF>1/tail-robust folds
precommitment.holdout_gate: only the train-selected sleeve is validated; no second-choice rescue
precommitment.promotion_gate: selected alpha survives holdout and combined F7 improves ROI/DD/worst-day/PF Pareto on train, holdout, full path and both severe tiers; >=3/4 train folds must be nonharmful
